## Scope expansion (Option B) — renderers now see full v2 state

After the first run revealed G8 FAIL (Doc 07/06/07b empty despite `concatenate: 38`),
two additional fixes were applied (Option B scope expansion per user decision):

1. **`graph.py:_make_output_node`** now passes `orch.state` (the shared
   orchestrator instance dict) to the render method, not the per-node LangGraph
   state. The LangGraph state only carries `stage_outputs` + `*_complete`; it
   does NOT carry the v2_* mutations from LOAD / MAP / REDUCE. Previously the
   renderers read from an empty dict and rendered "0 rows".

2. **`orchestrator.py:_build_ontology_shim`** now populates the v1-shape
   `state["ontology"]["subdomains"]` (a `{covered, not_covered}` bucket dict)
   from `state["aggregated_data"]["concatenated"]["subdomains"]` (set by
   `reduce_deterministic` → `concatenate`). The shim is also **re-invoked**
   at the end of `reduce_deterministic` so Doc 07/07b see the 38 subdomains
   when their render nodes run (the shim was first built during
   `load_baseline` with empty data and previously was cached forever).

Together these changes bring Doc 07 from 0 rows → 38 rows, Doc 06 from 0
clauses → 174 clauses, Doc 07b from 0 D-rows → 93 D-rows.
